earnings_guidance.event: AMMN reports a nine-month profit turnaround
earnings_guidance.headline: AMMN reports nine-month profit turnaround as sales rise 493.80%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Amman Mineral produced 580,713 metric tons of concentrate, up 87% year on year. Net sales totaled USD3.24 billion, including USD1.97 billion in exports and USD1.25 billion domestically.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Concentrate output increased 87% to 580,713 metric tons.

earnings_guidance.event: WMPP reports Q3 profit growth and sets a revenue target
earnings_guidance.headline: WMPP reports Q3 profit up 154%, targets up to 50% 2026 revenue growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Widodo Makmur Perkasa turned a year-ago loss into Rp92.9 billion net profit as sales rose 40% to Rp961.9 billion. Chicken carcass sales led growth, rising 70% to Rp750.3 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo turns profitable in nine-month 2026 results
earnings_guidance.headline: RMKO turns profitable with Rp1.2 billion 9M net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Royaltama Mulia Kontraktorindo’s 9M revenue rose 57.4% to Rp345.3 billion, while EBITDA reached Rp59.4 billion from a Rp9.3 billion loss a year earlier. A rights issue completed on 21 July raised Rp114.3 billion, cutting debt-to-equity from 0.54x to 0.19x and financial debt by 40.6% to Rp56.7 billion.

earnings_guidance.headline: FOLK reports Rp18.39 billion nine-month profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Multi Garam swung from a Rp8.27 billion loss in the same period a year earlier, with basic and diluted earnings per share at Rp4.51 versus minus Rp2.10. Net revenue rose to Rp14.45 billion from Rp14.05 billion.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX lifts the trading suspension on MKNT
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX lifts MKNT suspension as shares surge 2,300%
market_structure_policy.blurb: Trading resumed on 19 October at Rp1 after the suspension ran from 11 July 2024 to 16 October 2026. Remitra’s subsidiary RUM acquired 99.99% of group companies ALE and RSA on 27 October. Both were selected for Stage 3 of Danantara Investment Management’s waste-to-energy project, each in a consortium with SUS Indonesia Holding Limited.

deals_control.event: GMFI transfers shares to Danantara as a non-cash dividend
deals_control.headline: GMFI transfers a 65.77% stake to Danantara as a non-cash dividend
deals_control.blurb: InJourney’s stake in Garuda Maintenance fell to zero after 82.10 billion shares were transferred to Danantara on 2 November as an in-specie dividend, valued at around Rp1.56 trillion at Rp19 per share. Danantara now holds 65.77%, while GMFI said ultimate control remains indirectly with the Indonesian government.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: InJourney’s GMFI ownership fell to zero after the transfer.

deals_control.event: Nawasena agrees to acquire control of Idea Indonesia Akademi
deals_control.headline: Nawasena agrees to acquire 66.58% of IDEA
deals_control.blurb: Nawasena signed a conditional agreement on 2 November to buy 707.32 million Idea Indonesia Akademi shares from Eko Desriyanto and Idea Asia Investama. Completion remains subject to the agreement’s conditions, after which Nawasena must make a mandatory tender offer to public shareholders.

deals_control.event: LAPD shareholders appoint JSI Sinergi Mas as controller and approve capital increase
deals_control.headline: LAPD appoints JSI Sinergi Mas controller with 51% stake, approves capital increase
deals_control.blurb: At its 29 October meeting, shareholders approved raising authorized capital from Rp1.5 trillion to Rp1.6 trillion and a second rights issue with new Series B shares at a nominal Rp25 each. Existing shares will be designated Series A, and Bambang Rahardja Burhan resigned as director effective from the meeting.

deals_control.event: PKPK announces a DPAL acquisition and a 1:10 stock split
deals_control.headline: PKPK plans Rp722.2 billion DPAL acquisition and 1:10 stock split
deals_control.blurb: The purchase covers 720,374 shares from Deli Indonesia Raya and Karya Niaga Gemilang, lifting PKPK’s stake from 49% to 99.99%. It plans to use interest-free third-party financing, with payment due within 12 months of the share purchase deed. Shareholder approval for the split will be sought at an extraordinary meeting on 11 December.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

other.event: MNC Bank customer withdrawal disruption and OJK liquidity response
other.headline: BABP faces withdrawal disruption as branch cash-outs reportedly capped at Rp2 million
other.blurb: OJK described the problem as a technical short liquidity issue, not a solvency issue. MNC Bank customers also reported failed MotionBank transactions, and OJK advised them to use ATMs and branch offices temporarily while it evaluates supervisory steps.
other.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

capital_raising_buybacks.headline: TRIS reports Q3 sales up 12.2% and plans Rp10 billion share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Trisula's net profit rose 3.1% year on year to Rp82.7 billion. The buyback can cover up to 62 million shares, or 2% of paid-up capital, at no more than Rp165 per share, from 3 November to 2 February 2027.
